The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

This dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider after the driver cancelled trip TRP-02724 at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider is refunded the whole SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable. Driver — most of your account is accepted. Your GPS trace (EV-GPS-02724, weight 1.0) places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 21:23:45, the timestamp of your 'I'm Here' tap, and holds you there for a continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds — longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02724). Your arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival event (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral attaches. Your profile also raises no anti-farming bar (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 POL-NS-07 requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 also required — both limbs must hold). But none of that decides the fee. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (d) requires termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE — as you acknowledge — is none of them; the clause names it as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Because your stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded in full, and no compensation is payable. Your claim for the SGD 3.60 net figure under POL-NS-07 therefore fails: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full or POL-NS-10(g) applies, and neither condition holds. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags field on your profile was correctly not used for anything — it is not the field POL-NS-07 reads. Rider — you also succeed independently under POL-NS-04. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02724, weight 1.0) shows your locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45 inside the waiting window; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before cancelling 143 seconds later; and your own device track (EV-GPS-02724) was within the 100 m rider-presence radius for all 43 qualifying fixes, maximum 17.74 m from the pin. POL-NS-04 likewise refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. Amount: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02724, weight 1.0) records total_charged 4.50, a single cancellation_fee line of 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The trip never started — no distance fare, time fare, waiting-time fee, booking fee, ERP or surcharge — so the whole contested amount is the cancellation fee, and SGD 4.50 is returned to the rider. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this refund executes automatically on issue. The traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02724-01) is MISSING and carries weight 0.0; it was cited by both sides only for its absence. It cannot carry any fact, but its absence is itself citable, and POL-NS-06(i) — which requires a present and populated advisory of an admissible type — is not available to excuse or extend anything here, and nothing rested on it. No artifact deciding this case is impaired: the GPS trace, trip record, chat log and fare breakdown are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with 100 percent trace coverage, no gaps, intact chat sequence numbering and a cancellation line reconciling to the figure in force, so no POL-NS-08 discount and no POL-GEN-02 confidence cap below 1.0 applies. No contradiction between admissible artifacts, no disputes-with-counterparty history and no anti-farming trip on either profile engages POL-NS-09, so the case is decided rather than held. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The trip was terminated by the DRIVER at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, not by the rider. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and its limb (d) is satisfied only where the record shows termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; the clause states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fourth condition therefore fails on the face of the trip record and the SGD 4.50 charge cannot stand under the anchor clause.

evidence EV-TRIP-02724 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept Even taken at its best for the driver, the geometry points to the rider's outcome: the driver's own trace puts him inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius for a single continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds, beginning at 21:23:45 - the exact timestamp of his 'I'm Here' tap - with his closest fix 0.11 m from the pickup pin. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius and he nonetheless cancels under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded as a driver-education referral.

evidence EV-GPS-02724, EV-TRIP-02724 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The rider did coordinate, and the driver did not answer. The chat log shows the driver's message 'cannot find you, where are you' at 21:24:15 and the rider's reply 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45 - a locating message that names the rider's own position, sent inside the waiting window. The driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and no reply at all before terminating the trip 143 seconds later at 21:27:08, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are both made out on this record.

evidence EV-CHAT-02724, EV-TRIP-02724 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept The rider's own device track satisfies POL-NS-04 limb (c). Across the waiting window the rider track carries 43 qualifying fixes running from 21:21:35 to 21:27:51, and every one of them falls inside the STANDARD 100 m rider-presence radius of the pickup pin - maximum distance 17.74 m, mean 13.80 m, minimum 10.14 m - with the rider stationary throughout (the only distinct speed in the track is 0.0 km/h). The rider was at the pickup point for the whole of the wait; the rider was not absent from it.

kept With limb (a) (a locating message from the rider), limb (b) (no driver reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call) and limb (c) (the rider within the presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes) all satisfied, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider: the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable. This is an independent route to the same outcome as POL-NS-01 limb (d), and it does not depend on the driver's reason code at all.

This dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider after the driver cancelled trip TRP-02724 at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider is refunded the whole SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable. Driver — most of your account is accepted. Your GPS trace (EV-GPS-02724, weight 1.0) places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 21:23:45, the timestamp of your 'I'm Here' tap, and holds you there for a continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds — longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02724). Your arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival event (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral attaches. Your profile also raises no anti-farming bar (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 POL-NS-07 requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 also required — both limbs must hold). But none of that decides the fee. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (d) requires termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE — as you acknowledge — is none of them; the clause names it as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Because your stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded in full, and no compensation is payable. Your claim for the SGD 3.60 net figure under POL-NS-07 therefore fails: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full or POL-NS-10(g) applies, and neither condition holds. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags field on your profile was correctly not used for anything — it is not the field POL-NS-07 reads. Rider — you also succeed independently under POL-NS-04. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02724, weight 1.0) shows your locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45 inside the waiting window; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before cancelling 143 seconds later; and your own device track (EV-GPS-02724) was within the 100 m rider-presence radius for all 43 qualifying fixes, maximum 17.74 m from the pin. POL-NS-04 likewise refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.
